packb_serialize_pydantic_model: serialize a Pydantic BaseModel to bytes using ormsgpack with numpy and UTC support
unpackb_deserialize_bytes_to_model: deserialize ormsgpack bytes back into a Pydantic BaseModel with automatic type coercion
base_model_to_bytes_roundtrip: convert a Pydantic BaseModel to bytes including its component name for later reconstruction
bytes_to_base_model_roundtrip: reconstruct a Pydantic BaseModel from bytes using the component registry to resolve the model type
deserialize_unpacked_coerce_types: deserialize unpacked data into typed Python objects including numpy arrays, datetimes, and nested Pydantic models
